notice: This package is a reviewed plan only. It must not be applied until every named approval is recorded outside Git and supplied again as an execution flag.

costGuard.estimate: US$1.40-$2.00/month for a roughly 60 GB same-region recovery copy plus small S3 request, Inventory, and CloudTrail data-event charges; actual cost is usage-dependent and must remain at or below the owner-approved US$20 monthly ceiling.

rollbackLimits: Deleting unused IAM roles, disabling future Inventory reports, stopping a trail, and deleting an empty recovery bucket are reversible only before retained evidence or replicas are required.
The lifecycle rule only aborts unfinished multipart uploads, but aborted parts cannot be restored.
Compliance retention cannot be shortened or removed; legal holds may be removed only from the dedicated exercise object after retention is read back unchanged.
Object Lock can only be enabled when a bucket is created; a bucket created with Object Lock cannot later have Object Lock disabled.
Replication only covers new objects in this plan. Historical payload replication needs a separately approved S3 Batch Replication scope and cost review.
